subject.title: security(audit): flag control-plane exposure and plugin command surfaces

question: Should this broader PR own the final control-plane and plugin-command audit contract, and should command reachability be based only on runtime-slash/runtime command metadata rather than all `commandAliases`?
rationale: The PR changes operator-facing, machine-readable security-audit output and overlaps another open external PR, so cleanup automation should not choose the permanent audit contract alone.

options.title: Repair This Broad PR As Canonical
options.body: Have this PR filter command aliases to true chat command metadata, add real audit output proof, and supersede the narrower control-plane PR after maintainer review.

options.title: Land Focused Control-Plane First
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100965 for control-plane exposure and ask this PR to narrow to plugin command-surface auditing afterward.

options.title: Pause For Audit Naming
options.body: Pause both branches until maintainers settle the final check IDs, severity contract, and command metadata source.

recommendation.title: Repair This Broad PR As Canonical
recommendation.body: Have this PR filter command aliases to true chat command metadata, add real audit output proof, and supersede the narrower control-plane PR after maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent audit catalog and plugin-trust cleanup history makes them the clearest routing candidate for the operator-facing audit contract choice.
